description: EU trade mark (EUTM) search on EUIPO's official Trademark Search API: word mark, status, kind and feature, Nice classes, applicants and representatives, application, registration and expiry dates, with a link to the EUIPO record. Contains search by default, exact name on request, optional status filter. EU trade marks only (no national offices). Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_ip_australia_trademarks when you need IP Australia trade mark records by trade mark number. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

exact.description: true: the whole word element must equal query (default false: contains)

query.description: Trade mark word element, e.g. lego (letters, digits, spaces and & . ' - only)

status.description: Optional status: RECEIVED, UNDER_EXAMINATION, APPLICATION_PUBLISHED, REGISTRATION_PENDING, REGISTERED, WITHDRAWN, REFUSED, OPPOSITION_PENDING, APPEALED, CANCELLATION_PENDING, CANCELLED, SURRENDERED, EXPIRED, ACCEPTED

name: gov_tmview_trademarks
title: EU trade mark search on EUIPO's official Trademark Search
